observations: Three injected SQL errors were wrapped in Drizzle causes, so direct message assertions did not match.
The user-selection fixture passed updateVoice an options object instead of its real five-argument signature.
Residual recovery and foreign-organization expectations also failed.
earlierAttempts.resolution: Correct the test-only error assertion and method signature, then rerun the unchanged production baseline.

earlierAttempts.phase: corrected behavioral reproduction before production fix
observations: Both live statuses remained failed after the separate pointer write rejected, instead of rolling back.
An already-failed claim with a residual pointer returned null without attempting cleanup.
A foreign organization live claim was updated and returned a row.
earlierAttempts.resolution: Use an atomic, scoped D1 batch with a failed-owner guard for pointer cleanup.

observations: claim-discipline introspection failed because ownership query construction was eager in the scoped DB factory.
Two reconcile dynamic imports timed out at 5000 ms; a subsequent mock-state expectation returned unknown. Typecheck and full lint were running concurrently.
earlierAttempts.resolution: Delay the ownership query until the method is called. Rerun the identical regression command without competing quality jobs: 21 files and 426 tests passed, without changing reconcile code, assertions or timeouts.
